entries.label: Admin
entries.definition: Engineer permissions plus administer users, Project Assignments, effectivity restrictions and permission overrides on the project; view the audit trail (B.6).

entries.label: Design Lead
entries.definition: Engineer permissions; may hold Design Lead authority roles; approve EDR line-item breaks and interface breaks within the Role register area (B.6).

entries.label: Design Authority
entries.definition: Engineer permissions; may hold Design Authority authority roles; approve TSM statement breaks and bulk-confirm TSM supersessions within the area; approve for release where delegated (B.6).

entries.label: Engineer
entries.definition: View all project data within the allowed effectivities; create and edit the items owned or contributed to; raise review flags. May hold Technical Authority for Design, Design Approver and Discipline Lead roles (B.6, 5A.6).

entries.label: Viewer
entries.definition: View only, within the allowed effectivities; may comment and use the AI bar (B.6).
